sentences.text: In the Mainz-Bingen region, the Common Carder Bee has 572 reports over ten years, with a main season from April to September and the strongest numbers in August.
It has been recorded visiting flowers of Marsh Thistle (499 GloBI records), Devil's-Bit Scabious (266) and Greater Knapweed (261).
Further records show flower visits to Meadow vetchling (235), Creeping Thistle (221) and Bush Vetch (213).
It has also been recorded visiting field scabious (174 records) and Foxglove (173 records).
